item.title: SUPER TUX
item.description:
The game I’m writing about maybe is known among Linux people, but for me it is like a trip back in time to my youth, and the only game I played on Linux as a kid. This open-source Mario ripoff once amazed me so much that it was unbelievable joy when I found it again after many years. So I’m saving it here for myself, so my future me will find this post and have another moment of joy.

SuperTux FTW!

Download it here from the Official site
